replies.author: Xuph
replies.body:
Spawn timer needs to be much longer imo. TDM Maps that I have seen on tourneys usually have spawn timers with 4 seconds at least. It seems like it might be too big for TDM (in case we're talking about 5v5 or 6v6 which is most likely going to be the amount of players per team in the next tournament). I prefer having 1 gapple spawner in the middle which is not campbable (open and hard to get to) to make it challanging to control and putting the need to use strategies to control it. I'd replace the 2 other gapple spawners with arrow spawners. I can't tell if this is the map you showed me yesterday on the server but if it is, why did you change it's color D:

Other than all this ^ (LOL) the map is coolio, has very damn good aesthetics, just try to work on all that and it will be perefecto. Find me on teamspeak if you need help editing that <3
